study_area: Shiggaon Taluk, Haveri District, Karnataka, India

confidence.nodata_fix_status: outputs/lulc_confidence.tif previously declared nodata=-1.0 in its GeoTIFF header while actual invalid pixels were physically stored as 0.0 (0 pixels equaled -1.0 in the file). This was identified and FIXED directly in the file: nodata is now consistently 0.0, matching both the actual invalid-pixel values and lulc_prediction.tif's own nodata convention. Verified: valid confidence pixels are unchanged (bit-identical before/after), prediction/confidence valid-pixel masks now match exactly, and the production model and all classification outputs (lulc_prediction.tif, training_data.csv, metrics, class encoding) were not touched by this fix.

interpretation_guidance.GOOD: coverage >= 90% of true watershed area — safe to interpret directly.
interpretation_guidance.LOW: coverage < 75% — statistics reflect only a small, possibly unrepresentative fragment of the watershed. Do not present as if describing the whole watershed.
interpretation_guidance.INSUFFICIENT_DATA: valid pixel count below the defensible minimum (100 px) — statistics should not be interpreted at all.

known_limitations: Built-up is over-predicted relative to WorldCover reference prevalence.
Barren is over-predicted relative to WorldCover reference prevalence.
Water <-> Barren confusion exists because of heterogeneous reference labeling.
36/66 micro-watersheds have LOW or INSUFFICIENT_DATA coverage.
Only one Sentinel-2 date is currently used.
WorldCover is reference/pseudo-ground-truth and is not field-verified.
